set.body:
Work key: SITE01.3
Plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Immediate target: docs/local-demo-plan.md
Accountable role: Product owner with institutional operator and curator
Program scope: required

Scope: Turn institutional needs into explicit launch criteria and dependency changes.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Record accepted load/memory/latency targets, recovery point/time objectives, revocation bound and support envelope; reconcile deviations from existing PRD targets explicitly.
2. Compare the institution’s required intake with the local native-staging baseline and add explicit blocking remediation for missing modes. Record native-BIDS versus DICOM/XNAT and visualization choices. Add required EP7/EP8 to both program and Q03.3 dependencies; deferred scope is not implementation.
3. Publish the required-evidence matrix and distinguish permission to run a limited beta from a future primary-repository cutover.

Verification: Named owner/curator/operator acceptance of the scope matrix plus a checked mote dependency diff.
Expected evidence: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/SITE01.3/receipt.json
Evidence fields: exact source/artifact and configuration identity; commands or human procedure and observed outcomes; fixtures/data scope and environment; acceptance-criterion results, negative cases and limitations; reviewer/acceptance evidence when the task requires institutional input

External inputs:
- Institutional acceptance of targets and pilot scope

References:
- docs/institutional-readiness-plan.md#1-what-we-can-responsibly-stand-up
- docs/prd.md
- docs/local-demo-plan.md

Blocked by:
- SITE01.2: bd-01M4W5P46THC7WFA4FD0B1A68Z

Completion rule: satisfy every criterion with observed, source-bound evidence. Local fixtures and engineering checks cannot replace institutional approval, real-provider qualification, human accessibility or operator acceptance. No external outreach is authorized by this task.
set.title: SITE01.3: Set pilot targets and activate only required integrations
